article_summaries.title: Summer Camp - Arts and Crafts Week
article_summaries.summary: A live-game community event post for the Summer Camp season, covering the 'Arts and Crafts Week' theme, which highlights crafting jobs (Blacksmith, Cook), music boomboxes, and house block sculptures. It gives the expected in-game event schedule and explains how to find events through the Game Guide calendar and GO button teleport. The post is dated only relatively ('1 week, 5 days ago') so no absolute date can be confirmed.
